body:
## Pull request overview

This PR implements 14 Q2 2026 roadmap items, introducing a comprehensive suite of features for drag-and-drop, gestures, view enhancements, keyboard navigation, animations, and client notifications. The implementation bridges the @objectstack/spec schemas with the existing ObjectUI component system.

**Changes:**
- DnD framework integration via bridge patterns connecting @dnd-kit and HTML5 drag events to the ObjectUI `DndProvider` across kanban, dashboard, and calendar plugins
- Spec-aligned gesture and touch hooks (`useSpecGesture`, `useTouchTarget`) mapping schema configurations to native gesture handling
- Grid enhancements with grouping, row coloring, and gallery view improvements supporting Airtable-style features
- Keyboard shortcuts system (`useCrudShortcuts`) and view transition animations
- Client notification bridge (`useClientNotifications`) connecting server-side notifications to local context

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 20 out of 20 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| packages/react/src/hooks/useCrudShortcuts.ts | New hook registering standard CRUD keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+N/E/S/D, Delete, Escape, Ctrl+F) |

| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Added fade-in animation to view switcher transitions via `key` and Tailwind classes |
| packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx | Implemented `DndBridge` pattern bridging @dnd-kit events to ObjectUI `DndProvider` |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/useRowColor.ts | New hook mapping field values to Tailwind background classes for conditional row coloring |
